newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil power firms begun as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil power firms begun as a buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it started coverage of Brazilian power utilities Eletrobras and Eletropaulo as a buy.
-- It also said its 12-month target price for Eletrobras is 465 reais per share, but the price is likely to reach 575 reais within two years.
-- Regarding Eletropaulo, it said the company's estimated earnings are expected to increase from 8.00 reais per share in 1996 to 11.40 reais in 1997 and to 16.50 reais in 1998.
-- Analyst Charles Barnett recommends this stock on valuation and as an excellent play on Brazilian privatization.
-- Eletrobras preferred was down 0.9 percent to 332 reais, while Eletropaulo shares were not traded on the Sao Paulo bourse.
